metadata.description: Byrd Law Group internal marketplace for Clio Manage tooling.

plugins.name: clio-toolkit
plugins.description: Connect to Clio, analyze matters (deadline/task risk), open new MVA matters, run the MVA pre-litigation intake workflow, apply reusable task/deadline workflow templates to any matter, and upload or edit documents in Clio's document management. Bundles the clio, clio-matter-analysis, clio-mva-new-matter, clio-mva-intake, and clio-workflows skills.
